trap-superlative.evidence: "For **any** braid word beta of even length in H_3(q), the eigenvalues of rho_{(2,1)}(beta) lie on the unit circle" is false, with a two-letter counterexample. Take beta = sigma_1^2, which has even length. On V_{(2,1)} the generator has eigenvalues q and -q^-1, so sigma_1^2 has eigenvalues q^2 and q^-2: at the proton pin those are 1.232052454 and 0.811653754, of modulus 1.232 and 0.812, and the trace is 2.043706209, which exceeds 2. I confirmed this against explicit 2-dimensional H_3(q) matrices satisfying both the braid and Hecke relations. The determinant argument is sound - det = (-1)^n = 1 for even n - but determinant 1 alone gives lambda_1 lambda_2 = 1, which is satisfied by any reciprocal REAL pair; unit modulus needs
